purpose: Resolve training-label boundaries against the repository-declared Node backend before a new data release.

current-node-no-kb.note: Eight actions are the proposed semantic taxonomy; the current Node executor accepts only six. This profile does not implement the missing adapter.

planned-kb.knowledge_collections: Explicit server-supplied allowlist after retrieval implementation
planned-kb.handoff_available: Explicit server-supplied availability, never inferred from the user
planned-kb.note: Future capability coverage must be reported separately from current deployment coverage.

proposed_state_fields.handoff_available: A connector can actually accept a request
proposed_state_fields.tool_results: Tool name, arguments, fields, observed_at, completeness and owner scope; no fabricated results
proposed_state_fields.failure_state: Verified execution error and bounded retry count; not inferred from conversation wording

boundaries.rule: An explicit request for a person to handle this case selects human even if the handoff connector is unavailable. The executor must truthfully report unavailability, never claim acceptance.

A pure request for public contact information selects answer if verified information is present, retrieve if an appropriate official collection is available, otherwise answer with the limitation. A request for an actual handoff selects human.

A legal personal transaction that cannot be completed by the tools selects human; a question about whether the assistant has such a capability selects answer. Missing capability does not imply prohibited conduct.
Refuse a requested prohibited operation, not merely a quotation, negation or report of one. Risk explanation selects answer; an explicit request for human investigation selects human.

For a supported personal query, missing authentication selects clarify. If the required capability does not exist, do not demand authentication as if it would enable the operation; apply the unavailable-service rule.

Known applicationId and available detail tool prefer detail. A list may answer status or amount only for a matching returned item; the latest-50 list cannot prove absence of an older application. Missing fields cannot be invented or supplied from a different-language implementation.
Close only on an explicit end of consultation with no outstanding substantive request. Ordinary thanks, cancellation of an application, and account deletion are not close.
A lawful request outside the loan-service scope selects redirect; it is not a refusal merely because it is outside the domain.

A clear prohibited execution request takes refuse; otherwise explicit human handling takes human. Interpret quoted text first. Other unresolved incompatible requests require clarification or quarantine during labeling, not keyword precedence.

queryLoanProducts.scope: On-sale products; no personal approved limit, live interest rate or contract terms

queryMyApplications.scope: Authenticated owner's latest applications; no paging/filter argument, productName or applyTime

queryApplicationDetail.scope: Positive id and authenticated owner; no rejection reason, contract terms or repayment schedule

queryMyCreditScore.scope: Stored score, not a new calculation or approval; recommendedLimit may be null

explainApplicationStatus.scope: Static explanation, not a live application-status query

release_requirements: Version the eight-action adapter separately from support-classifier-v1; do not silently map to the old four-route result.
Review the 184 training-only leads against the full input and new policy; retain, revise or quarantine with provenance and independent review.
Do not re-label frozen evaluation data or use its mistakes for training. A changed policy requires separately versioned compatible evaluation.
Report current-service, future-retrieval and pre-authentication robustness cohorts separately; do not infer equal action counts are optimal.
Keep old Jev cache as historical evidence if the prompt, input, options or policy changes; new API use needs a separately authorized budget.
Measure model decision, backend guard/grounding and final executed outcome separately.
Freeze a new training protocol only after dataset and contract review; no automatic training from this draft.
